product.name: Relaxed Fit Cargo Pants
product.description: Relaxed-fit pants in cotton twill with a casual but not oversized silhouette. Waistband with drawstring, covered elastic, and mock fly. Diagonal side pockets, welt back pockets, and bellows leg pockets with flap and snap fasteners. Straight legs with stitched pleats at knees and drawstring at hems.
